## Overview

MarkdStage v4.0.2 introduces the Windows Desktop distribution package set. GitHub Releases
include portable x64/ARM64 packages, signed sideloading MSIX packages and their public
certificate, the Canvas Extension ZIP, and the offline CLI tarball.

This release also improves packaged-app launches, current-workspace handling, Archify diagram
imports, PowerPoint export diagnostics and recovery, and desktop skill installation.

## Compatibility and migration

This release is backward compatible for existing Windows Desktop users. Microsoft Store
submission is a separate local Partner Center operation and is not performed by the GitHub
Release workflow.

| Area | Migration |
| --- | --- |
| Version-pinned installation | Update the pinned tag to `v4.0.2`. |
| Canvas Extension | Install `.github/extensions/markdstage` from the `v4.0.2` tag. |
| CLI | Update `@markdstage/markdstage` to version `4.0.2`. |
| Desktop | Use the v4.0.2 Windows package for the matching architecture. |
| Microsoft Store | Create `MarkdStage-Store.msixupload` locally and submit it separately through Partner Center. |
